admission.justification: Without a completion-relative floor expensive ticks can continuously occupy the interpreter, and clearing pending domains would trade performance for stale projections; the shared completion hook and retained-domain timeline protect both.

applicability: Live dashboard projection ticks using ChangePacer, including prime, failure and cancellation drain.
conditions: At default one-second interval the added rest is one to three seconds; an explicitly larger interval keeps its configured larger floor.
Pending domain notifications during work or rest survive completion/failure/watcher-health transitions and are consumed at the next eligible deadline.
Degraded watchers retain full-refresh wakes; quiet heartbeat keeps its existing 15-second scheduling interval.
exclusions: Watcherless replay keeps its existing fixed sleep cadence.
The cap bounds added scheduler rest, not total event-to-publication latency or the duration of a running/next tick.
Publication/subscription ownership and stable delta/ETag semantics remain unchanged.

evidence: requirements/MIK-R40-v2-reviewer-read-latency-on-git-trees.md rule 8 live pacing; exact post-B1 source notes/reports/260928-MIK-L40-worker-R2-evidence/final-2026-10-03/candidate-reader-post-b1.json sha256:ff7a5201d4ed37a6d2e109d9a8d3b9374adbd5f44009b7e7f686274ed218b6b2; independent R1/R2 plus notes/reports/260928-MIK-L40-review-R3.md (SHA-256 c9a9ea931c18de68182a0f1f12d57cc7e72d29358ed463328ce3d11ca3c988fd); phase-specific performance evidence remains pending

statement: After the actual live tick finishes or its worker drains on cancellation, the next tick's added scheduler rest is max(interval, min(actual_tick_duration, 3 seconds)).
